verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a video SDK platform like Daily, but the evidence pack never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The closest item covers end-to-end encryption, HIPAA BAAs and the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, which are adjacent privacy controls rather than a way to opt out of tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
